title: JudgeGPT: AI has entered active justice delivery
description: The success of JudgeGPT should not be measured by how much technology a court deploys. It should be measured by whether citizens spend less of their lives waiting for justice

title: Xiaomi builds its own 3nm AI chip to give future EVs powerful onboard intelligence

title: OpenAI to end agreement with SpaceX's AI coding tool Cursor, deepening Musk-Altman clash
description: Aug 28 (Reuters) - OpenAI said on Friday that it plans to stop providing AI models to Cursor, the coding-tool company now owned by Elon Musk's SpaceX, in a further escalation of the bitter rivalry
